candidate_source_dossiers.description: Restarts a Cloud Foundry application in a rolling manner or quickly, by stopping all instances simultaneously
Restarts a Cloud Foundry application in a rolling manner, without causing downtime
Resolve Cloud Foundry org, space and app GUIDs by providing technical names or GUIDs
Create a new service instance within a selected Cloud Foundry space.

Upgrade an SAP HANA Cloud instance to a target version determined by the chosen upgrade scope on its current release cycle. Optionally rotates a snapshot beforehand for a fresh restore point. If no version matches the chosen scope, no changes are made.

Rotate a single snapshot on an SAP HANA Cloud instance: deletes the oldest existing snapshot (if any), then creates a new one. Useful for keeping the snapshot up to date with the current database state. If the instance has no snapshots, only the new one is created.
Delete an SAP HANA Cloud instance. By default, deletion is blocked if any service bindings are present. Optionally, you can remove all bindings first and then delete the instance.

Obtain mTLS credentials for the SAP HANA Cloud administration APIs. SAP Automation Pilot manages the admin-api-access service instance and binding lifecycle, creating them if needed and periodically rotating the binding. Repeated runs return the same binding until rotation is due.
Used for rolling restart of Kubernetes deployment.
Polls rolling restart process for specific Kubernetes resource until it is done.
Used to delete a Kubernetes resource.
Creates a new service instance
Wait for an operation to finish successfully
Enable service plan assignment with unlimited and numeric quota usage to specified subaccount
Assign role collections to the specified user, group or attribute. If missing, the user will be added to the subaccount.

Execute an HTTP request. Supported authentication methods: Custom Authorization Header; OAuth 2.0 Client Credentials, Password, and Refresh Token Grant Flows; Basic Authentication; IAS Technical User Certificate Authentication; no authentication.
Execute an HTTP request. The HTTP response is treated as a sensitive value.
Manage stored BTP destinations, including optional identity certificate reads using the selected tenant context or service key.

Promote an integration flow to a target environment by updating externalized parameters and upserting Partner Directory string parameters, then restarting the flow. Both parameter lists are optional. Omitting both simply restarts the flow.
Import specified transport requests in Cloud Transport Management service for a given transport node
Creates a new file or replaces an existing file in a GitHub repository
Clone a Jira issue
Monitors an already started Jenkins build until it reaches a desired status

Poll a Concourse build every 30 seconds until it reaches a terminal state (succeeded, failed, errored, or aborted). Fails if the build does not complete within the polling window of 45 minutes (90 polls).

Retrieve log entries from SAP Cloud Logging for a given time range. Supports both JSON and OpenTelemetry log formats. Optionally filter results by using an OpenSearch domain-specific language (DSL) query clause.
Invoke a tool on a remote MCP server.
Execute a command multiple times and provide a different input for each execution
Command to execute Python script
